mods.name: Cytra Creative
mods.changelog:
First release: a creative-server (CMP) toolkit; every feature is a module you switch on and off with /cc modules.
- Regions and a selection wand, particle outlines, map-style and 3D renders, .litematic copy and paste with undo
- Creative Guard: per-region rules for building, explosions, fire, fluids, pistons, mob spawning and more
- Lab: private test dimensions with their own tick rate, world border and snapshots
- Build Share + Gallery, Scale Model, Showcase, Timelapse (GIF) and Camera flight paths

Install on the server with Fabric API. Players don't need it; with it (and MaLiLib) they get the menu (/cc menu) and smooth camera playback.

mods.name: Cytra Hub
mods.changelog:
- Install Cytra mods you don't have from the Updates tab (and the mod's page): shows client/server/both and required mods with a tick or cross; missing ones never block the install
- Update all and auto-update only update mods you have
- Updates tab, SHA-checked downloads and the jar-swapping helper (from 0.3.x)
- Commands tab on each mod page
